definitions: A legal contract or agreement between at least two parties that outlines confidential material, knowledge, or information that the parties wish to share with one another for certain purposes, but wish to restrict access to or by third parties.
An agreement in which one party agrees not to disclose information that another party considers confidential.
examples: We had to sign an NDA before seeing the product.
The company requires an NDA from all new employees.
Breaching an NDA can have serious legal consequences.
